skill_title: Add, subtract, multiply and divide; powers of 10
notes: 20-item bank. CAPS mix: 5 L1 (mechanical) + 8 L2 (one-step word) + 7 L3 (multi-step word). Fresh SA contexts: Pick n Pay till slips, fuel runs, payroll, unit conversions for distance and mass.

stimulus.inline: A learner adds two amounts on her calculator: 1 234 and 567.

items.question: Calculate 1 234 + 567.
workingSteps: Line up units, tens, hundreds and thousands.

stimulus.inline: Multiplying by 100 moves the decimal comma two places to the right.

items.question: Calculate 4,5 × 100.
workingSteps: Multiplying by 100 moves the decimal two places right.

stimulus.inline: Dividing by 10 moves the decimal comma one place to the left.

items.question: Calculate 8 760 ÷ 10.
workingSteps: Move the decimal one place to the left.

stimulus.inline: Mr Dlamini buys three items at Spar costing R150, R85 and R47. He totals them without VAT adjustments.

items.question: Calculate the total: R150 + R85 + R47.

stimulus.inline: A learner subtracts two decimal numbers as a calculator check.

items.question: Calculate 12,4 − 3,7.

stimulus.inline: Thandi drives from Polokwane to Pretoria, a distance of 320 km. Her car uses 8 litres of petrol per 100 km. Petrol costs R23,50 per litre.

items.question: Calculate the total petrol cost for the one-way trip.

stimulus.inline: Mr Naidoo earns a gross monthly salary of R18 400. The following monthly deductions apply: PAYE tax R2 870, UIF R184, pension fund R1 472.

items.question: Calculate Mr Naidoo's net (take-home) monthly pay.
workingSteps: Total deductions = R2 870 + R184 + R1 472 = R4 526.

stimulus.inline: A rug measures 2,5 m × 3,2 m. The shop charges R280 per square metre.

items.question: Calculate the total cost of the rug.

stimulus.inline: A school orders 240 textbooks. The supplier offers a bulk price of R28 800 for the full order.

items.question: Calculate the cost per textbook.
workingSteps: Cost per book = Total ÷ Number of books.

stimulus.inline: A bakkie at Makro carries 24 boxes of canned food per trip. The community needs 408 boxes delivered.

items.question: How many full trips are needed to deliver all 408 boxes?
workingSteps: Trips = Total boxes ÷ Boxes per trip.

_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_ADDITION_CARRY: Drops a carry when adding multi-digit numbers (e.g. 1 234 + 567 = 1 791).
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_SUBTRACTION_ORDER: Subtracts in the wrong order (smaller − larger when larger − smaller intended).
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_PLACE_VALUE_ALIGN: Misaligns place value when stacking numbers for addition/subtraction.
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_DIVISION_REMAINDER_DROP: Drops a remainder when context requires rounding up (or treats exact division as inexact).
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_DIVISOR_INVERSION: Divides the divisor by the dividend instead (or multiplies when divide was needed).
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_DECIMAL_PLACEMENT_PRODUCT: Places the decimal comma incorrectly in a product (off by a factor of 10).
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_DECIMAL_PLACEMENT_QUOTIENT: Places the decimal comma incorrectly in a quotient.
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_DECIMAL_ALIGN_SUB: Misaligns decimal commas when adding/subtracting decimals.
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_POWER_OF_10_DIRECTION: Shifts the decimal in the wrong direction when ×÷ 10/100/1000.
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_UNIT_CONVERSION_DIRECTION: Multiplies when the conversion requires division (or vice versa).
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_AREA_FORMULA: Misapplies area formula (e.g. adds dimensions instead of multiplying).
